name: bcrypt validation cost on pgwire connect
claim: Every cold pgwire connection pays one bcrypt-verify on the way in. At test bcrypt-cost (4) p99 stays under 300 ms across 50 validations. Production cost-12 will run ~50× higher; the connection pool keeps this off the hot path for warm reuse. The number we publish here tracks regressions in the validation path itself, not in bcrypt's CPU envelope.
